arg.name: dds_config
arg.description: CYCLONEDDS_URI for every process this launch starts (default: the environment's, else swb_launch's localhost profile)

arg.name: carla_host
arg.description: CARLA host; empty: the world server config's (localhost)

arg.name: carla_port
arg.description: CARLA RPC port; empty: the world server config's (2000)

arg.name: world_port
arg.description: the CARLA world server's port on 127.0.0.1

arg.name: swb_carla_world_config
arg.description: the CARLA world server's config file (map_alias, traffic_manager, spectator, weather presets)

arg.name: ssv2_port
arg.description: SSv2's ZMQ port on the bridge; empty: 5555

arg.name: entity
arg.description: the scenario entity the vehicle agent drives

arg.name: npc_motion
arg.description: kinematic | tracked: how SSv2-driven NPCs move; empty: the bridge config's (tracked)

arg.name: weather
arg.description: a weather preset or name:=value fields (swb_carla_world's names); empty: the config's

arg.name: gap_trace_dir
arg.description: write the SSv2-vs-CARLA gap trace here; empty: none

arg.name: contact_report_dir
arg.description: write CARLA's contact report here (the physical verdict); empty: none

arg.name: vehicle_catalogs
arg.description: vehicle catalog(s), comma- or colon-separated, the ego spec_hash check reads beside the installed sim_vehicle_spec one (a car from another repository); added to the config file key vehicle_catalogs; empty = none added

arg.name: npc_contact_sensors
arg.description: true: contact sensors on NPC vehicles too; empty: the world server config's

arg.name: vehicle_physics
arg.description: the vehicle spec's carla_physics.yaml on the ego and agent vehicles; none: the blueprints' own
